name: CE_GL_ACCOUNTS_CCID_
description: CE_GL_ACCOUNTS_CCID_ is the audit table for CE_GL_ACCOUNTS_CCID. CE_GL_ACCOUNTS_CCID contains information about code combination identifiers per bank account use.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_USE_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the bank account use.

columns.name: ASSET_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the cash account of the bank account.

columns.name: CASH_CLEARING_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the cash clearing account.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGES_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the bank charges account.

columns.name: GAIN_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the account that posts the realized exchange rate gains.

columns.name: LOSS_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the account that posts the realized exchange rate losses.

columns.name: ON_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the On-account account.

columns.name: UNAPPLIED_CCID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: UNIDENTIFIED_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the unidentified account.

columns.name: FACTOR_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the factor account.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CLEARING_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the receipt confirmation account.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the remittance account.

columns.name: AR_SHORT_TERM_DEPOSIT_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the receivables short term deposit account.

columns.name: BR_SHORT_TERM_DEPOSIT_CCID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BR_REMITTANCE_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the bills receivable remittance account.

columns.name: BR_FACTOR_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the bills receivable factoring account.

columns.name: BANK_INTEREST_EXPENSE_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the bank interest expense account.

columns.name: BANK_INTEREST_INCOME_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the bank interest income account.

columns.name: XTR_ASSET_CCID
columns.description: Accounting flexfield identifier for the treasury cash account.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Actione Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1's and 0s for each row. 1 will be stored if the value has changed and 0 will be stored if the value hasn't.
